description: Formats a moment relative to now in the user's language: 'just now', '5 min ago', 'yesterday at 4:20 PM', 'in 3 days', and an absolute date from a week on. AddTempoBlazor() registers the default TmRelativeTimeFormatter over ITmLocalizer (Tm_Time_* strings) and the registered TimeProvider; register your own after it to replace it.

examples.title: Deterministic formatting in a test
examples.code:
var formatter = new TmRelativeTimeFormatter(localizer, fakeTimeProvider);
formatter.Format(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.AddMinutes(-5)); // "5 min ago"
